About this explorer

This application contains 10,795 directory records, including 10,229 populated phone entries and 8,865 approximate coordinates. Spatial overlay assigns 8,863 points to a current district; two source coordinates fall outside the national polygon and are flagged for review.

The administrative map contains Ghana (ADM0), 16 regions (ADM1) and 261 districts (ADM2). The national baseline is the OCHA/HDX Ghana COD-AB dataset, valid from 8 March 2021 and reviewed on 30 October 2025. Its 260-district layer is completed with Guan District—created after the referendum—using OpenStreetMap relation 13804589, with Guan removed from Hohoe Municipal and joined to Oti Region.

Most pins are representative points for a matched town, village or locality—not exact campus coordinates. Current region and district values are calculated from each coordinate by point-in-polygon; they may differ from the directory’s older listed region.

Boundary sources: OCHA/HDX COD-AB (CC BY-IGO) and OpenStreetMap Guan District (ODbL). Directory records were retrieved on 2 September 2026.

Press Ctrl + K to search. Favourites and theme choice remain on this device.
